name: trimmean
expr: t0 = trimmean(v, 0); t20 = trimmean(v, 20); tM = trimmean(M, 40);
comment: Sig m=trimmean(x,percent[,dim]): mean after trimming percent/2 from each end. v=[1..8 100 -50]: percent=0 -> plain mean 8.6; percent=20 trims 1 from each end (the 100 and -50 outliers) -> 4.5. Matrix per-column: trimmean(magic(5),40) = [12.666667 12 13 ...].
